data.name: Adreno-Defibrillator
data.description: Provides one-time, short-lived resuscitation upon death, given that the Helldiver's body is still intact. Increases stim effect duration by 2.0s. Provides 50% resistance to arc damage.
effects: Provides one-time, short-lived resuscitation upon death, given that the Helldiver's body is still intact.
